limitations: Only 12 of 1833 eligible files were captured from 1972 discovered files. Numerous named Customize files were skipped, including VM/scale-set, extension, gallery, model, CloudServiceResource and additional classic model implementations. This does not establish package-wide customization completeness or absence.

Read all 12 supplied source captures and all supplied README, project and tsp-location context. All evidence kinds remain unknown. Findings rely on non-Generated Customize placement combined with concrete compatibility code, explicit obsolete contracts and the factory's hand-authored-stub comment, not on unknown provenance alone.

Generated counterparts, API history, linked sources and TypeSpec were not independently read. The factory comment attributes classic-type removal to the spec; that is not independently established service retirement or generator behavior.

The VirtualMachines and SharingSubscriptionIds auto-properties are explicitly unwired placeholders, not working aliases. The three common-SubResource projections do create arrays from identifiers; InstanceViewCapacityReservations simply forwards a nested list.

Every captured CloudService model factory, collection operation, enumerator and JSON/persistence read/write body throws NotSupportedException. Their operation, Pageable, AsyncPageable or serialization interface signatures are not functioning LROs, custom pagers or codecs.

Do not generalize the throwing behavior to every member: the two static identifier helpers construct ResourceIdentifier, HasData returns false, format getters return J, and model constructors/properties remain declared. No initialization of the captured get-only CloudServiceData collections is shown.

No SDK compilation, service requests or runtime behavior was tested. Generator addressability denotes plausible generalized API shaping, not present support, a proven generator deficiency or measured reduction; unsupported compatibility stubs remain unclear.

Coverage is partial: 12 of 1,833 eligible files are captured, 135 named Customize files were skipped for the review budget, and no conclusion about uncaptured SDK customization instances or absence follows.

The captured compatibility files do not include their Generated counterparts or a historical API baseline; comments about prior generated names and removed TypeSpec definitions are not independently verified.

The CloudService throwing signatures preserve API shapes but demonstrate no working LRO, paging, JSON serialization, or service calls; generatorAddressable is an opportunity judgment, not an assertion of current generator support.
The two omitted obsolete resource declarations are source-bounded candidates and remain inconclusive pending separate assessment; accepted/revised decisions are AI-reviewed, not human-verified.
